_comment: LEGACY (Mac container 'fiction-openclaw' retired 2026-06; kept for reference/rollback — see DEPLOY.md). Apply with: docker exec -i fiction-openclaw node openclaw.mjs config patch --stdin < orchestration/openclaw-deepseek-patch.json ; then: docker restart fiction-openclaw. Registers DeepSeek's current models (built-in deepseek-chat is retired) and sets the default agent model. No secrets here — apiKey is referenced from the container's DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env.
